faq.q: Is an IRS federal tax lien the same as overdue county property taxes?
faq.a: No. Identify the creditor and actual notice. Federal tax-lien review and local property-tax review are different issues that may both need attention.

faq.q: Does discharging a house from a federal lien erase the tax debt?
faq.a: No. The IRS distinguishes release of a lien from discharge of a specific property. A property discharge does not by itself establish that all tax debt is forgiven.

faq.q: Can a cash buyer automatically remove an IRS lien?
faq.a: No. A purchase proposal does not determine IRS requirements or approval. Have the title team and qualified tax professional coordinate the actual closing plan.

faq.q: What should I gather before discussing the sale?
faq.a: Gather the actual notices, relevant ownership records and the closing team's requested information. Share tax documents only through verified private channels and request a written list of unresolved requirements.
